item.title: Road Snowfall Warning
item.description: Rain turns to snow above 600 metres this evening, and till Friday morning 1 to 2 cm may accumulate.

item.title: Road Snowfall Warning
item.description: Snow showers expected to affect the road from this evening through Friday morning. 5 to 10 cm may accumulate about the summit, with lesser amounts down to 600 metres.
